name: Hidden file or directory created in world-writable path (Linux)
description: Creation of a dot-prefixed (hidden) file or directory under /tmp, /var/tmp or /dev/shm (T1564.001).
query: file where host.os.type == "linux" and event.action in ("creation", "rename") and file.name like~ ".?*" and file.path like ("/tmp/.*", "/var/tmp/.*", "/dev/shm/.*")
